description: This file implements core USP Broker functionalities related to managing USP services, including registration, deregistration, handling notifications, subscriptions, and communication with USP services over UDS. It defines data structures and functions for maintaining a list of connected USP services, processing messages, and managing data model paths and permissions.
external_methods: Client-specific functions related to MTP and subscription routing
